topic.title: 신용 점수 상담
topic.description: 신용 점수는 금융 거래의 신뢰도를 나타내는 중요한 지표입니다. 이 대화를 통해 신용 점수에 대해 배우고 개선 방법을 알아봅니다.

korean_scripts.korean_text: 제 신용 점수가 얼마인지 알고 싶습니다.
현재 신용 점수를 확인해 드릴게요. 음... 좋은 편은 아니네요.
신용 점수를 어떻게 하면 더 좋게 만들 수 있을까요?
연체 없이 꾸준히 상환하는 것이 가장 중요합니다.
알겠습니다. 그 외에 다른 방법도 있나요?
신용카드 사용 내역을 관리하고, 불필요한 조회는 피하는 것이 좋습니다.

foreign_scripts.foreign_text: Hello, I have something I'd like to consult about.
foreign_scripts.chunked_text: Hello, | I have something I'd like to consult about.

foreign_scripts.foreign_text: Yes, how can I help you?
foreign_scripts.chunked_text: Yes, | how can I help you?

foreign_scripts.foreign_text: I want to know what my credit score is.
foreign_scripts.chunked_text: I want to know | what my credit score is.

foreign_scripts.foreign_text: I will check your current credit score for you. Hmm... It's not very good.
foreign_scripts.chunked_text: I will check your current credit score for you. | Hmm... | It's not very good.

foreign_scripts.foreign_text: How can I make my credit score better?
foreign_scripts.chunked_text: How can I make my credit score better?

foreign_scripts.foreign_text: Consistently paying on time without delays is most important.
foreign_scripts.chunked_text: Consistently paying on time | without delays | is most important.

foreign_scripts.foreign_text: I understand. Are there any other ways besides that?
foreign_scripts.chunked_text: I understand. | Are there any other ways | besides that?

foreign_scripts.foreign_text: It's good to manage credit card usage and avoid unnecessary inquiries.
foreign_scripts.chunked_text: It's good to manage credit card usage | and avoid unnecessary inquiries.
